blocks.html:
This method revokes an API key. It sends a request to the 
[Revoke API Key](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#api-keys\_postapikeysidrevoke) API route.

types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

The redacted form of the token, useful 
for displaying the API key.
